title: Squared expectation deviation bound
statement: Let $\phi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ that is $\varepsilon$-biased for some $\varepsilon\geq0$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The absolute difference between the $\phi$-weighted expectation of $f^2$ after identifying the Boolean cube with the sign cube, and the uniform mean of $f^2$ on the sign cube, is at most $\|\widehat f\|_1^2\varepsilon$, where $\|\widehat f\|_1$ is the sum of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of $f$.
